args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.

args.observation: Lab report for packaging compression theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch; theory NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

metrics.answerText:
## Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict from the independent lab reports

**Supported: bearing seat machining.** The lab report found **"Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED."** — that 0.4 mm undersize measurement, present on every recalled batch, is the finding it rests on.

**Ruled out: ceramic coating cure.** "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."

**Ruled out: packaging compression.** "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."
